style_guide.geometry: Sunken analogue telegraph stations, seven-arm ceramic repeaters, cable loops, listening bells, fossil beds and manufactured coral

style_guide.lighting: Neon and phosphor names indicate source-coloured solids, not light simulation
style_guide.avoid: No real marine biology, acoustic signaling, cable tension, salinity pressure, water reflection or erasure claims
